title: Beyond RLHF and NLHF: Population-Proportional Alignment under an Axiomatic Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Population-Proportional Alignment (PPA) to measure how well the model's policy reflects the full distribution of heterogeneous evaluator preferences (e.g., across different simulated expertise levels, conversational styles, and item preferences) rather than defaulting exclusively to majority consensus or Condorcet winners.
